require 'openssl'
require 'socket'
require 'uri'

module CertValidator
  class ProxyAwareTLSClient
    TRUSTED_PROXY_HEADER = 'X-Forwarded-Client-Cert'
    PROXY_VERIFIED_HEADER = 'X-Client-Cert-Verified'
    
    attr_reader :store, :proxy_mode, :verification_depth

    def initialize(ca_bundle_path:, proxy_mode: false, max_depth: 5)
      @store = OpenSSL::X509::Store.new
      @store.add_file(ca_bundle_path)
      @store.purpose = OpenSSL::X509::PURPOSE_SSL_CLIENT
      @proxy_mode = proxy_mode
      @verification_depth = max_depth
      @chain_cache = {}
    end

    def verify_peer_certificate(cert_pem, chain_pems: [], headers: {})
      cert = OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(cert_pem)
      chain = chain_pems.map { |p| OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(p) }

      if @proxy_mode && proxy_pre_verified?(headers)
        result = validate_with_proxy_trust(cert, chain, headers)
      else
        result = full_chain_validation(cert, chain)
      end

      result
    end

    private

    def proxy_pre_verified?(headers)
      verified_value = headers[PROXY_VERIFIED_HEADER]
      return false if verified_value.nil?
      normalized = verified_value.to_s.strip.downcase
      normalized == 'success' || normalized == 'true'
    end

    def validate_with_proxy_trust(cert, chain, headers)
      # When proxy has pre-verified, we still perform full trust store
      # validation — proxy verification is defense-in-depth, not a bypass
      return failure('Certificate expired') if cert.not_after < Time.now
      return failure('Certificate not yet valid') if cert.not_before > Time.now
      
      # Always validate against our trust store regardless of proxy status
      store_result = validate_against_store(cert, chain)
      return store_result unless store_result[:valid]

      # Check key usage extensions
      ku_result = verify_key_usage(cert)
      return ku_result unless ku_result[:valid]

      success(cert, trust_source: :proxy_and_local_verified)
    end

    def validate_against_store(cert, chain)
      ctx = OpenSSL::X509::StoreContext.new(@store, cert, chain)
      ctx.purpose = OpenSSL::X509::PURPOSE_SSL_CLIENT
      
      if ctx.verify
        success(cert)
      else
        failure("Store validation failed: #{ctx.error_string}")
      end
    end

    def full_chain_validation(cert, chain)
      return failure('Certificate expired') if cert.not_after < Time.now
      return failure('Certificate not yet valid') if cert.not_before > Time.now

      ctx = OpenSSL::X509::StoreContext.new(@store, cert, chain)
      ctx.purpose = OpenSSL::X509::PURPOSE_SSL_CLIENT
      
      if ctx.verify
        success(cert, trust_source: :full_validation)
      else
        failure("Validation failed: #{ctx.error_string}")
      end
    end

    def build_chain_order(cert, chain)
      return [cert] if chain.empty?
      
      ordered = [cert]
      remaining = chain.dup
      current = cert
      depth = 0

      while depth < @verification_depth && !remaining.empty?
        issuer = remaining.find { |c| current.issuer.to_s == c.subject.to_s }
        break if issuer.nil?
        ordered << issuer
        remaining.delete(issuer)
        current = issuer
        depth += 1
      end

      # Require chain to terminate at a self-signed certificate
      last = ordered.last
      unless last.issuer.to_s == last.subject.to_s
        return nil
      end
      ordered
    end

    def verify_key_usage(cert)
      ext = cert.extensions.find { |e| e.oid == 'keyUsage' }
      return success(cert) if ext.nil?  # No KU extension is acceptable
      
      ku_value = ext.value
      unless ku_value.include?('Digital Signature')
        return failure('Missing Digital Signature key usage')
      end
      success(cert)
    end

    def success(cert, trust_source: :unknown)
      { valid: true, subject: cert.subject.to_s, trust_source: trust_source }
    end

    def failure(reason)
      { valid: false, reason: reason }
    end
  end
end

# Rack middleware for certificate validation behind reverse proxy
module CertValidator
  class RackMiddleware
    def initialize(app, ca_bundle:, proxy_mode: true)
      @app = app
      @validator = ProxyAwareTLSClient.new(
        ca_bundle_path: ca_bundle,
        proxy_mode: proxy_mode
      )
    end

    def call(env)
      cert_pem = extract_client_cert(env)
      return unauthorized('No client certificate') unless cert_pem

      headers = extract_proxy_headers(env)
      chain_pems = extract_chain(env)

      result = @validator.verify_peer_certificate(
        cert_pem,
        chain_pems: chain_pems,
        headers: headers
      )

      if result[:valid]
        env['client.cert.subject'] = result[:subject]
        env['client.cert.trust_source'] = result[:trust_source]
        @app.call(env)
      else
        unauthorized(result[:reason])
      end
    end

    private

    def extract_client_cert(env)
      env['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_CLIENT_CERT'] || env['SSL_CLIENT_CERT']
    end

    def extract_chain(env)
      raw = env['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_CLIENT_CERT_CHAIN']
      return [] unless raw
      raw.split('-----END CERTIFICATE-----').map { |c| c + "-----END CERTIFICATE-----" }.reject { |c| c.strip.length < 30 }
    end

    def extract_proxy_headers(env)
      {
        'X-Client-Cert-Verified' => env['HTTP_X_CLIENT_CERT_VERIFIED'],
        'X-Forwarded-Client-Cert' => env['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_CLIENT_CERT']
      }
    end

    def unauthorized(reason)
      [401, { 'Content-Type' => 'text/plain' }, ["Unauthorized: #{reason}"]]
    end
  end
end
